messages.subject: Re: Changing this default possble? lavaan WARNING: some cases are empty and will be removed:
parts: > > lavaan WARNING: some cases are empty and will be removed:

This warning message means that in the data.frame (at least for the
variables used in the mdoel), some observations have only 'NA' for all
variables. These observations are called empty cases, and should be removed.

Yves.
